units.source_text: 古歌：“山城木幡里，原有马可通。

en.t: An old poem says: In the village of Kohata in Yamashiro, there was once a road passable by horse.

units.source_text: 只因思君切，徒步来相逢。”

en.t: Yet because I long for you so deeply, I come on foot to meet you.
This appears in the Shu i Collection.

units.source_text: 木幡山位在京都与宇治之间，故引用此古歌句。

en.t: Mount Kohata lies between Kyoto and Uji, so this old poem is quoted here.
